Bilateral lower limb venous color doppler study has been performed.
Both the common femoral and superficial femoral veins show evidence of normal
color flow and venous waveform. No evidence of thrombus is seen. Phasic variation
is noted. Compressibility and augmentation are present.
The popliteal vein and calf vein on both sides show evidence of normal color flow
and venous waveform. Phasic variation is noted. No evidence of thrombus is seen.
No evidence of deep venous thrombosis in current study.
Test performed by JMS on an emergency basis.
